name: email-excluded-same-localpart-different-domain-both-fire-invalid
description: excludedSubtrees rfc822Name contains two full mailbox constraints sharing the same local-part ('foo') but with different host parts: 'foo@bar.example.com' and 'foo@baz.example.com'. The leaf's SAN is 'foo@bar.example.com' — matching the first excluded constraint exactly. Both exclusions must be active; the leaf falls inside the first excluded subtree and the chain must be rejected.
references: Go #77952 — full-email constraint map keyed only by local-part
notes: Probes implementations that intern full-email constraints into a hash keyed by local-part alone. The Go 1.26 constraint set used the local-part as the map key, so the second constraint silently overwrote the first; only 'foo@baz.example.com' survived to be checked. The leaf's 'foo@bar.example.com' then matched no surviving exclusion and was incorrectly accepted.
Symmetric variant (same local-part on the *permit* side, leaf matching only one of the two) is also worth a separate test if the permit-side data structure shares the same bug.
